description: Codemods rewrite code by transforming its abstract syntax tree, applying the same change across thousands of files identically. jscodeshift is the canonical toolkit for JavaScript. AST precision beats regex because it understands code structure.

print("before: foo(x) in 1,200 files")
print("after:  bar(x) in 1,200 files, 0 missed")

assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'source', 'target', 'method', 'risk', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
